news.q: Blake Corum ran wild on his 26th birthday as the Rams beat the Packers 26-13 on Thanksgiving Eve, Nov. 25. How many rushing yards did he have?
news.fact: It was a career high, on 32 carries with a touchdown.

news.q: This week the FCC approved SpaceX’s plan for AI data centers in space. How many "orbital compute modules" did it authorize SpaceX to deploy?
news.fact: The FCC called it the first authorization for such a project.

easy.q: How many teams play in the NBA?
easy.fact: Twenty-nine are in the U.S. and one, the Raptors, is in Canada.

easy.q: Counting Rudolph, how many reindeer pull Santa's sleigh?
easy.fact: Rudolph joined the team in a 1939 Montgomery Ward booklet.

easy.q: Niagara Falls is made up of how many separate waterfalls?
easy.fact: They are the Horseshoe, American and Bridal Veil falls.

easy.q: In what year did the Vietnam War end with the fall of Saigon?
easy.fact: Saigon was renamed Ho Chi Minh City the next year.

easy.q: How many Pitch Perfect movies came out from 2012 to 2017?
easy.fact: The first one made the song "Cups" a surprise hit.

medium.q: To the nearest foot, how high is the net in men's indoor volleyball?
medium.fact: It's 7 feet, 11⅝ inches; the women's net is about 7 feet, 4 inches.

medium.q: How many seasons did the sitcom Community run?
medium.fact: Fans' rallying cry was "six seasons and a movie."

medium.q: How many miles long is the Blue Ridge Parkway?
medium.fact: It links Shenandoah and Great Smoky Mountains national parks.

medium.q: How many different NASA space shuttles flew in space?
medium.fact: The test shuttle Enterprise only made glide flights in the atmosphere.

medium.q: How many U.S. presidents have had the first name James?
medium.fact: Madison, Monroe, Polk, Buchanan, Garfield and Carter: James is the most common presidential first name.

hard.q: In 1934, New Hampshire's Mount Washington recorded a world-record wind gust. How fast was it, in miles per hour?
hard.fact: It stood as the world record for 62 years.

hard.q: Erling Haaland set the Premier League's single-season scoring record in 2022-23. How many goals did he score?
hard.fact: He broke the 34-goal mark set by Andy Cole and Alan Shearer.

hard.q: In what year did Charles Dickens publish A Christmas Carol?
hard.fact: The first printing sold out within a week.

hard.q: How many minutes long is The Godfather (1972)?
hard.fact: It won three Oscars, including Best Picture.
